minutes.headline: Commission approved the 985 Mass Ave porch determination and voted to mail a notification letter to district owners.
minutes.summary: The Architectural Preservation District Commission approved the June and July minutes and a determination of applicability for porch repairs at 985 Massachusetts Avenue. It voted to send an information letter to property owners in the district, with one member preferring to wait. It also authorized a member to engage Town Counsel about selling the Brooks house, and reviewed other historic properties. The meeting ran under technical difficulties, with no audible broadcast feed.

votes.motion: Approve the June 13 and July 11 meeting minutes as amended.
Approve the determination of applicability for porch work at 985 Massachusetts Avenue.
Send the information letter to property owners in the Architectural Preservation District.
Authorize a member to engage Town Counsel on the best way to put the Brooks house sale intent on a warrant.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member recalled that the town's earlier sale of the Jones house, with preservation covenants, went for a low auction price.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair will find out how the mailing and postage would be paid for.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the town put some projects out to bid and wants a revised estimate for the Town Hall and Ritter work.

decisions.decision: The chair will return the signed determination of applicability to the building inspector and ask to be alerted if the permit drawings differ significantly from the historic photo.
May minutes deferred to the September meeting; the chair will write them from the video.
The chair will contact the assessor's office for the owner mailing list, find out how postage is paid, and circulate the cleaned-up letter before mailing.
Any bylaw change for town meeting would focus on extending the district to the Chestnut and Mass Ave intersection.
A member will talk with the Municipal Building Design Committee about the commission's intent for the Brooks house.
The chair will ask when Town Counsel hours are available and reserve time, to discuss the Brooks house and merging the Historical Commission with the commission.
The chair will meet the new select board chair before September to convey concern about inactivity on Town Hall and Ritter.
Next meeting scheduled for the 12th of September.

The owner letter and a possible bylaw change to extend the district toward the Chestnut and Mass Ave intersection would affect which property owners fall under historic review.
Votes on this recording are marked not audible, so the town's official minutes are the better check on who voted how.
